rules.build:
export CC="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-gcc"
# As in Debian: pick the vector code at run time. case "$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" in x86_64*) export LIBXXH_DISPATCH=1 ;; esac
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS"
rules.install:
export CC="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-gcc"
case "$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" in x86_64*) export LIBXXH_DISPATCH=1 ;; esac
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make PREFIX="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ LIBDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" \ install
